data.message:
The mod is great for people like me in the third world who lack gaming privacy! A few additions could improve the experience.

For example, in the final mission, Virginia was missing (Kelvin was dead too), so only Timmy and I were there.

Could you add a settings file to configure if Virginia appears or not? Also, adding config options to disable mutant-only, cannibal-only, or all female characters would be appreciated.

Thanks
